_comment: These are hard numeric limits. Claude's reasoning/thesis step may NEVER override these values. Any proposed trade that violates a rule here must be rejected before it reaches review_equity_order, with no exceptions regardless of how strong the thesis sounds.

_changelog.change: Adopted at the account owner's request after the one-month live review: (1) take-profit tiers 15/30/50% (25% each) -> 8/15/30% (one third each) plus a breakeven stop once peak gain since entry reaches 8%; (2) market_regime filter (SPY below its 50-day average or VIX above 25 -> at most 3 positions and high-conviction-only new entries); (3) an afternoon intraday stop-loss/take-profit check (INTRADAY_RISK_TASK.md); (4) pre_earnings_trim (sell half the trading day before a report); (5) stop_loss.volatility_stdev_multiplier 2.5 -> 2.0, stop_loss.max_stop_pct 0.15 -> 0.10, entry_extension.max_extension_pct 0.10 -> 0.08; plus time_review for held positions that never reach the first take-profit tier within 10 trading days.

execution.note: mode must be manually changed from 'dry_run' to 'live' by the human. Claude must never change this value itself, and must refuse to place live orders while mode is 'dry_run'.
execution.operator_decision: 2026-10-19: the account owner explicitly instructed going live immediately, skipping the dry-run period (dry_run_min_cycles_before_live 10 -> 0), with no per-trade confirmation. To stop live trading, set mode back to 'dry_run' -- note that this also stops automatic stop-loss/take-profit sells on positions already held.

universe.supplementary_scan_note: Robinhood scan 'FriesTrader supplementary movers', created via the Robinhood MCP's create_scan tool: asset type STOCK, market cap $2B-$50B, 30-day average volume >= 1M, last price >= $5, and relative volume (dayVolume / 30-day average volume) >= 2, sorted by relative volume descending so the top supplementary_scan_max_candidates rows are the most unusual-volume names. Relative volume is an expression filter (the enum FILTER_TYPE_RELATIVE_VOLUME ignores its 30-day length), so edit it with create_scan + this scan_id, not update_scan_filters. Additive to watchlist_max_candidates, not shared with it -- the watchlist's own slots are never crowded out by scan results.

signal_thresholds._comment: A Step-1 candidate qualifies for a Phase A news search + thesis (i.e. counts as a 'notable signal') if it meets ANY ONE of these three, computed from data already pulled in Steps 1-2 (no extra API calls). This is a mechanical gate, not a judgment call. Currently-held positions are exempt and always get a thesis regardless of these thresholds.

position_sizing.max_concurrent_positions_note: 2026-10-27: raised 4 -> 5 at the account owner's request, to put idle cash to work (with 4 slots full, about 43% of the account sat in cash). min_cash_buffer_pct still applies on top of this cap.
position_sizing.min_top_up_note: A top-up only fires if the computed buy amount clears max($1.00 broker minimum, min_top_up_usd, min_top_up_pct_of_target x target_size for that candidate's conviction tier). Below that, skip without calling review_equity_order -- a top-up smaller than this doesn't move the position meaningfully, and letting headroom shrink toward zero every cycle otherwise generates a long tail of dust-sized orders as the position converges on target. Applies to top-ups only, never to new-entry sizing.
position_sizing.min_new_entry_conviction_note: One of 'low', 'medium', 'high'. A new entry (a candidate not already held) is only opened at this conviction or above -- with the default 'medium', a 'low'-conviction thesis (mixed evidence, sentiment-driven, sector-wide, or any risk_flags) never takes one of the max_concurrent_positions slots, keeping them free for stronger candidates later. Held positions are unaffected: their stop-loss, take-profit, conviction-trim, and exit checks still run at any conviction. Set to 'low' to allow low-conviction new entries again.

stop_loss.breakeven_note: Once a position's peak gain since its holding period's entry (highest daily high since entry, or the fresh price if higher, versus average cost) reaches breakeven_trigger_pct, its stop is raised to average cost: it is sold in full as soon as the price is at or below average cost. A floor on top of the regular stop, never a loosening of it. Set to null to disable. See scripts/stop_loss.py.
stop_loss.note: mode is 'fixed' or 'volatility_scaled' -- toggle only. 'fixed' uses the flat hard_stop_pct for every symbol. 'volatility_scaled': stop_pct per symbol = clamp(volatility_stdev_multiplier * stdev of daily close-to-close returns over volatility_lookback_trading_days, min_stop_pct, max_stop_pct), recomputed fresh from get_equity_historicals each cycle; falls back to fallback_stop_pct if historicals are unavailable or the symbol has fewer than 10 daily bars. Every open position must have this stop checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock. A good new narrative does not cancel a stop-loss.

take_profit.tiers_note: 2026-11-20: lowered from 15/30/50% (25% each). In the first live month every losing exit had first been in profit (peak gains +1.8% to +14.4%, two of them at about +14%) and the average buy was +2.7% after 5 trading days but -1.0% after 10, so the first tier now sits at +8%. A tier at or below the highest tier already fired this holding period counts as fired (scripts/take_profit.py), so a schedule change never fires a lower tier after the fact.
take_profit.note: Tiered partial take-profit, not a single full-exit threshold. Every open position must have this checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock — this account is short-term oriented, not buy-and-hold. A good new narrative does not cancel a take-profit tier any more than it cancels a stop-loss. Each tier fires once (per holding period, i.e. since the position last closed to zero) when gain first reaches it, selling sell_fraction_of_position of the position's quantity at that moment — see PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 5 for the exact mechanics. After all three tiers have fired, the remaining quantity is held long indefinitely; only the stop-loss still applies to it. See sell_reentry_lock for re-entry lock behavior.

conviction_trim.note: Trims a held position to its conviction-tier target once conviction has been 'low' or 'medium' (i.e. not 'high') for min_overweight_conviction_cycles consecutive cycles and the overage exceeds overweight_trigger_pct -- see scripts/conviction_trim.py. See sell_reentry_lock for re-entry lock behavior.

sell_reentry_lock.note: Applies to every sell reason: a loss-closed sell locks re-entry until price drops below the sale price; a gain-closed sell locks until price drops below the sale price or gain_close_max_trading_days trading days pass, whichever comes first. See scripts/entry_gate.py.

wash_sale_avoidance.note: Toggle only -- set enabled to false to turn this guard off entirely; no other change needed. IRS wash-sale rule applies per taxpayer across ALL accounts, not per account, so this checks linked_accounts, not just account_number. Blocks BUYS only (new entries and top-ups) -- never blocks a stop_loss/take_profit/exit_existing sell, since risk management must never bend to a tax outcome; those sells are instead logged with a wash-sale flag if one applies, for the human's own tax tracking. This cannot prevent a wash sale caused by a purchase made LATER in another linked account after an agentic-account sell -- those accounts are outside this pipeline's control; only the human can avoid that side.

entry_price_gap.note: Hard ceiling on buys -- a gap this large skips the buy this cycle even if the thesis still reads fine, same principle as a stop-loss. Never applies to sells. Checked in Phase B Step 4 (price-based staleness check), before Step 5's risk enforcement -- not part of the execution.mode live-order gate.

entry_extension.note: Hard ceiling on buys -- skips the buy this cycle if current_price is more than max_extension_pct above its own lookback_trading_days-day moving average, same principle as entry_price_gap. Never applies to sells.

earnings_blackout.note: Skips new entries and top-ups when the symbol's next earnings report is within blackout_trading_days trading days (0 = today), so fresh money isn't put on a binary event. Never applies to sells.

market_regime.note: Risk-off when the benchmark's fresh price is below the simple average of its last ma_lookback_trading_days daily closes OR the volatility index is above vix_threshold; missing data fails safe to risk-off. Risk-off caps new-entry capacity at risk_off_max_concurrent_positions and raises min_new_entry_conviction to risk_off_min_new_entry_conviction for that cycle. It never forces a sell of a position already held, and top-ups are unaffected. Checked in PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 7 via scripts/market_regime.py. Set enabled to false to turn it off.

pre_earnings_trim.note: Sells sell_fraction of a held position in the last trading_days_before trading days before its next earnings report (a report today counts only if it is after the close or its timing is unknown). Exempt: conviction 'high' AND the breakeven stop already armed. Fires once per report. A sell, so never blocked by a loss-limit halt. Checked in PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 5 via scripts/pre_earnings_trim.py.

time_review.note: Phase A rule for held positions: once a holding period's opening buy is at least window_trading_days trading days old and the position's peak gain since entry never reached the first take-profit tier, the thesis must cite a specific company-disclosed fact dated after the opening buy that still supports holding; otherwise its direction is exit_existing. See PHASE_A_TASK.md Step 3.

intraday_risk_check.note: A second, afternoon run on weekdays (INTRADAY_RISK_TASK.md, about 2:15pm Central) that re-runs only the stop-loss (including the breakeven stop) and take-profit checks on open positions and executes any sell they trigger, through the same live-order gate. It never buys and never runs conviction-trim, pre-earnings-trim or exit_existing. Positions are fractional shares, which Robinhood only accepts as market orders, so broker-side stop or limit orders cannot carry these exits; a second daily check is the substitute.

early_exit_guard.note: Within window_trading_days of a holding period's opening buy, an exit_existing sell requires a new_fact_date after the entry thesis's date -- a thesis can't reverse on facts it already had. Never blocks stop_loss/take_profit/conviction_trim.
